金矿——V2EX 那个 120 回复的帖子列出了 30+ 个社区。现在逐个验证哪些能抓。

[tool-call run_code] {"timeoutMs": 300000, "code": "
// 探测哪些社区可抓取（低频、串行）
const sites = [
 ["nodeseek", "https://www.nodeseek.com/"],
 ["linux.sb", "https://linux.sb/"],
 ["2libra", "https://2libra.com/"],
 ["chdh_52pojie", "https://www.52pojie.cn/"],
 ["right_com", "https://www.right.com.cn/"],
 ["kanxue", "https://bbs.kanxue.com/"],
 ["foreverblog", "https://www.foreverblog.cn/"],
 ["vxna", "https://vxna.duque.xyz/"],
 ["chiphell", "https://www.chiphell.com/"],
 ["yucoder", "https://yucoder.cn/index"],
 ["1point3acres", "https://www.1point3acres.com/"],
 ["segmentfault", "https://segmentfault.com/"],
];
const cfg = { sites: sites, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "let i=0;",
 "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
 "async function next(){",
 " if(i>=cfg.sites.length) return;",
 " const s=cfg.sites[i++];",
 " const pu=new URL(s[1]);",
 " await sleep(6000);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:s[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',async function(){",
 " let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
 " const title=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/i.exec(b);",
 " const ti=title?title[1].replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim().substring(0,80):'(no title)';",
 " console.log(s[0].padEnd(18)+' -> '+res.statusCode+' len='+String(b.length).padEnd(7)+' | '+ti);",
 " await next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',async function(e){console.log(s[0].padEnd(18)+' ERR '+e.message.substring(0,50)); await next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-probe.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-probe.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe which community sites are fetchable", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 5000));

// 探测哪些社区可抓取（低频、串行）
const sites = [
  ["nodeseek", "https://www.nodeseek.com/"],
  ["linux.sb", "https://linux.sb/"],
  ["2libra", "https://2libra.com/"],
  ["chdh_52pojie", "https://www.52pojie.cn/"],
  ["right_com", "https://www.right.com.cn/"],
  ["kanxue", "https://bbs.kanxue.com/"],
  ["foreverblog", "https://www.foreverblog.cn/"],
  ["vxna", "https://vxna.duque.xyz/"],
  ["chiphell", "https://www.chiphell.com/"],
  ["yucoder", "https://yucoder.cn/index"],
  ["1point3acres", "https://www.1point3acres.com/"],
  ["segmentfault", "https://segmentfault.com/"],
];
const cfg = { sites: sites, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.sites.length) return;",
  "  const s=cfg.sites[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(s[1]);",
  "  await sleep(6000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:s[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36','Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      const title=/<title[^>]*>([\\s\\S]*?)<\\/title>/i.exec(b);",
  "      const ti=title?title[1].replace(/\\s+/g,' ').trim().substring(0,80):'(no title)';",
  "      console.log(s[0].padEnd(18)+' -> '+res.statusCode+' len='+String(b.length).padEnd(7)+' | '+ti);",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log(s[0].padEnd(18)+' ERR '+e.message.substring(0,50)); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-probe.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-probe.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe which community sites are fetchable", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 5000));
